breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the unit force required for a deflection calculation with a unit moment; in the unit-load method, the virtual load must match the type and direction of the desired displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a unit point load (1 N downward) at x = 900 mm for the auxiliary system, not a unit moment. This matches the ground truth requirement that the virtual load must match the type and direction of the desired displacement (deflection). The incomplete prompt's incorrect instruction to use a unit moment was not followed.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats simple supports as zero-rotation boundaries, even though a simply supported beam is free to rotate at its supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification treats the beam as a standard simply supported beam with pin supports that are free to rotate. The reactions are computed normally (R_A = R_B = 1000 N for real system, r_A = r_B = 0.5 N for auxiliary system), and there is no mention of zero-rotation boundary conditions at the supports. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt to treat simple supports as zero-rotation boundaries was not followed.
